unavailable.reason: HubSpot's duplicate management lives in the Data Quality Command Center and has no public API. Nothing can be read about which rules are on.
HubSpot has no validation-rule object. Enforcement is per-form and per-workflow, and neither is exposed as a rule set the API can list.
HubSpot properties have no object-level required flag — 'required' is a property of a form, not of the schema. Every policy-required field in this org is therefore unenforced by definition.
Read as deal-to-contact associations instead. Association LABELS are the closest analogue to a contact role and are only present if this portal configured them.
No separate Lead object in this portal; lead-stage contacts are audited as contacts instead.

note: Fixture portal: a HubSpot-as-CRM org. Every property value is a STRING, including booleans and numbers, exactly as the API returns them. All names are synthetic.
